item.title: Daily News for Saturday, July 25, 2026
item.description: Two threads run straight into your practice today. The first is public-institution AI governance made concrete: reporting that Canada insists a human always decides study-permit and visa outcomes, while applicants say they can't tell where the algorithm ends and the officer begin...
